headline: OpenAI's posted notice says its gpt-5.4-cyber model would leave the developer service on 1 Oct 2026, about 20 days after the notice, while its policy normally promises three to six months.
score_reason: Pool score 3 lowered by 1: the notice dates from 11 Sep 2026 and the shutdown date, 1 Oct 2026, is before 2 Oct; the original outlet was blocked and the story is a niche developer matter.
importance_line: Developers who built on gpt-5.4-cyber may have had little time to move, and OpenAI's page names no replacement model, but it is not known whether OpenAI used its safety-or-compliance exception, and no one has confirmed the model was actually switched off.
summary: FourWeekMBA reports, after reading OpenAI's deprecations page (its list of models being retired), that gpt-5.4-cyber was listed on 11 Sep 2026 with a shutdown date of 1 Oct 2026, about 20 days by FourWeekMBA's own count. OpenAI's policy sets at least 6 months' notice for general models and at least 3 months for specialised versions unless safety or compliance concerns require faster action; the page gives no reason, and FourWeekMBA did not confirm the model was actually removed.
notes: Original outlet MIXED Reality News (blocked, HTTP 403). Written from FourWeekMBA, which read OpenAI's deprecations page; the 20-day figure is FourWeekMBA's own arithmetic and no policy breach is alleged.
